messages.軽い消耗で撃てる1コインの打撃E.G.Oで、不利なマッチを高い最大威力で撃ち落と: A 1-Coin Blunt E.G.O that can be fired at a light cost, suited to shooting down unfavorable Clashes with its high maximum power.
messages.高い最大威力: マッチ威力は12~26(解析Ⅲで14~28)。コイン威力+14の: **High maximum power**: Clash Power 12–26 (14–28 at Threadspin Ⅲ). A single Coin with +14 Coin Power, so it grows with higher SP.
messages.ランダムな状態異常: 的中時に火傷・出血・振動・破裂・沈潜のどれか1つを付与する: **Random status effect**: On hit, inflicts one of Burn, Bleed, Tremor, Rupture, or Sinking. The type cannot be chosen, so it is hard to make it the centerpiece of a team built around a specific status effect.
messages.パッシブ「異形発作」: ターン開始時に体力が25%未満なら体力15回復と保護2。: **Passive — Uncontrolled Morph**: If his HP is below 25% at Turn Start, he heals 15 HP and gains 2 Protection. Situations where he gets wiped out in one go from Stagger are likely common, so it is more of an insurance effect.
messages.軽さ: 必要資源は色欲3・憂鬱1、精神消耗は10。侵蝕スキルは無い。: **Lightweight**: Requires 3 Lust and 1 Gloom, with a Sanity cost of 10. It has no Corrosion skill.
messages.強敵の攻撃を撃ち落とすマッチ用として温存し、危ない場面で使う。: Save it as a Clash option for shooting down strong enemy attacks, and use it in dangerous moments.
messages.コイン威力の比重が大きいので、精神力が高いうちに撃つ。: Coin Power makes up a large share, so fire it while his SP is high.
messages.耐性は憂鬱・嫉妬が脆弱(×2)、怠惰が抵抗(×0.75)。: Sin resistances: Fatal to Gloom and Envy (×2); Endured against Sloth (×0.75).
messages.Ⅲ: 基本威力が12から14になり、付与する状態異常が3から6になる。: **Ⅲ**: Base Power goes from 12 to 14, and the status effect inflicted goes from 3 to 6.
messages.りょ・ミ・パ助手: S1が色欲で、必要資源の色欲を出せる。出血も付与できるため、: **[R.B. Sous-chef](persona:1204)**: His S1 is Lust, supplying the required Lust. He also inflicts Bleed, meshing with randomly inflicted Bleed.
messages.黒雲会副組長: S2が色欲、S3が憂鬱で、必要資源の両方を出せる。出血を軸にする: **[Kurokumo Clan Captain](persona:1208)**: His S2 is Lust and S3 Gloom, supplying both required affinities. A Bleed-centered Identity.
